statement: The prescribed unscaled q7 admits an integral Hall group lift in F2/gamma15 satisfying both genuine Drinfeld cycle equations. The complete class14 affine system has 5030 rows, 2497 variables, exact rank2066 and nullity431, with every earlier free parameter retained. An explicit integer solution is verified in all original matrix rows and all associative words through degree14, hence yields a finite jet over Z_p for every prime.
